messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticed a sustained KV cache memory uptick on gpu-34 between 02:00–07:00 UTC. Longctx routes (seq>4096) are holding pages and overall pages_pinned climbed ~3x. pprof snapshot attached.

maya: pprof extract:
```
# heap profile: kv.pages pinned
  312 kB  40.1%  40.1%  kv/slab.go:527      allocateBigChunk
  128 kB  16.5%  56.6%  kv/cache.go:214     pinPagesForRequest
  96 kB   12.3%  68.9%  kv/lease.go:88       extendLease
```

kevin: Interesting. Any recent infra changes that could increase chunk sizes? batching heuristics? :thinking:

priya: We shipped the new batching heuristic two days ago — increased batch_max_tokens from 2048->4096 for certain clients to reduce RPCs. We saw higher contiguous kv allocations (bigger context windows => larger KV slices). Could explain fragmentation.

nate: That aligns with what I simulated — larger batches increase chance of allocating many adjacent pages, which hurts compaction. Two quick mitigations: 1) apply a per-tenant soft quota on kv_residency, 2) add a short TTL lease for longctx entries so they don't stay pinned forever.

nate: Example config snippet we could try (short-lived):
```
kv.tenant.soft_quota.tokens: 1e7
kv.tenant.eviction_policy: "reuse_score+LRU"
kv.entry.lease_ttl_ms: 30000
```

maya: perf-bot fired an alert around 03:12: 
perf-bot: anomaly detected: metric=kv_cache.pages_pinned, node=gpu-34, factor=3.2, window=4h

kevin: I can open a rollback PR to revert the batch_max_tokens bump for longctx-tagged routes and add per-tenant residency metrics (kv_residency_samples, kv_reuse_score). I'll also add a short leak-rate gauge.

priya: Thanks — if we roll that back quickly we should see fragmentation drop. Also suggest increasing compaction frequency for slab 7 for 24h as a stopgap.

nate: Long-term: we should add a tenant-level residency sampler + quota enforcement (soft reject -> degrade to smaller model variant) rather than hard eviction. Also instrument re-use histograms so eviction targets low-reuse pages first.

maya: Assigning action: @kevin take batching rollback + metrics, @nate draft quota design, @priya coordinate short compaction increase. Will monitor mem for 12h and report back. :thumbsup:
